title: zesty shattering vietnamese grapefruit juice pho
description: this pungent, nostalgic vietnamese dish features grapefruit juice, savory flavors, and a soothing, shattering heat.
instructions: heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
add the beef bones and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
add the onion, garlic, ginger, star anise, and cinnamon stick, and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
add the grapefruit juice, fish sauce, sugar, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil.
reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
remove the bones and spices from the pot and discard.
add the rice noodles to the pot and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until they are tender.
serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro and a squeeze of grapefruit juice.
cook the noodles according to the package instructions, then drain and set aside.
warm the serving bowls by placing them in the bamboo-tray over hot water.
ladle the hot broth into the bowls through a fine-mesh sieve, and add the cooked noodles and garnishes.
